text: Waiting for a world to be unearthed by language, someone sings the place where silence is formed. Later she will verify that the sea does not exist because it shows itself furious, nor does the world. That is why each word says what it says and also more and something else.

translation.title: Waiting for a World to Be Unearthed...
translation.editorial_note: The prose-poem argument is kept compact, preserving the excess of language over simple naming.
